query_analysis.original_query: What are the critical safety protocols when depressurizing gas-liquid separators with high H₂S content?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and explain the essential safety procedures and precautions required when depressurizing gas-liquid separators containing high concentrations of hydrogen sulfide.

clarification_questions: What is the typical H₂S concentration range in the gas-liquid separators?
